question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Capable of being bent or pulled into different shapes
solution: The correct answer is **"Ductile."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Ductile"** means capable of being stretched or bent into different shapes without breaking. (बिना टूटे विभिन्न आकारों में खींचने या मोड़ने में सक्षम) • **Example:** *Gold is a **ductile**__ metal that can be drawn into thin wires.* • *​*Thus, capable of being bent or pulled into different shapes means **"ductile."** • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Lithe**: means thin, supple, and graceful. ((व्यक्ति या उनके शरीर के लिए प्रयुक्त) लचीला तथा सुरुचिपुर्ण ढंग से मुड़नेवाला, लचकदार और नम्य) • **Willowy**: means slender and graceful like a willow tree. (विलो पेड़ की तरह पतला और सुंदर) • **Lissome**: means thin, supple, and graceful. ((मनुष्य के शरीर के लिए प्रयुक्त) पतला एवं लचीला) 39:Ta89, The correct answer is **"A single morsel of food was not eaten by him at his daughter's wedding."**
